name: Tanabata Kyoudai no Hanashi.
source:
Orihime and Natsuhiko are twins that were born on July 7th, Tanabata.
They always do everything together, and see each other as two halves of the same person.
Will they be able to continue their special relationship? Or will they be torn apart like the Orihime and Hikoboshi of the Tanabata legend?
